name: gitcraft-studio-node
description: Browser-side runtimes for GITCRAFT Studio checks: three.js (engine previews of materials, terrain, FX, blockouts) Phaser 3 (Tiled map loading) the Khronos glTF-Validator and three.quarks (FXCraft emitter export) and axe-core (PIXELCRAFT accessibility rules). Installed into ~/.gitcraft/studio/node by scripts/install-studio.sh; nothing here is copied into projects.
